normative_contract.SMART: Explicit canonical subject exclusions and literal text negatives are distinct predicates. Do not infer both without semantic justification. About concerns content/topic rather than a catalogue category. Not only is not a prohibition. A subject exclusion rejects any matching canonical subject; text negatives search title/author/subjects/description.
normative_contract.TITLE_AUTHOR: Complete supplied literal is matched against title OR author; SMART grammar is not applied. Do not drop request prefixes or punctuation.
normative_contract.EXACT_IDENTIFIER: Complete ISBN10/13 or OL work ID is accepted identity syntax in SMART; identity existence is not needed for executable status.
normative_contract.session: Explicit refinements preserve unrelated accepted fields; chip removal removes only addressed items.

requested_output: For each review_id independently author only justified expected fields and decision/execution; include semantic reason, candidate eligibility example and AI_REVIEWED provenance. Do not read original labels or parser/source/results. Freeze authored values before any comparison. Use production field names title_text/author_text/exact_text/subjects/exclude_subjects/exclude_terms/rating_min/rating_max, decision and executable. Partial unresolved fields must stay visible.
